data.narrative:
Solinftec is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (277810.KQ), with primary focus on three same-stage, same-sector private peers: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method uses total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $76M. The peer-median method anchors to the median valuation of the three comparable firms at $1.8B, with a range spanning $1.6B to $2.0B. This substantial discrepancy reflects the methodological tension between internal fundraising history and external market comparables.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $65M to $2.0B, with a median point of $913M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty regarding which framework better represents fair value: whether Solinftec trades closer to its capital-efficiency trajectory or to peer market multiples. Resolution depends on revenue scale, growth trajectory, and customer concentration—data not present in this analysis. The peer-median method carries greater weight given the availability of direct stage and sector comparables, but the stage-progression result cannot be dismissed without clarity on Solinftec's revenue and unit economics relative to peers.
